verdict.rationale: The evidence shows n8n as a workflow builder where users can connect LLM providers and assemble agents that process their own data, for example the marketing use case 'Generate customer insights from reviews'. That is a developer building block for constructing insight workflows, not a documented in-product feature that surfaces AI-generated insights or suggestions about the user's data. No built-in insights or recommendations capability is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
